The attached screenshots are visual references ONLY for the composition of news thumbnails using dark photography with centered white typography. Do not copy their content, logos, websites, dates, layouts outside the individual thumbnail or colored elements.
BACKGROUND PHOTO: A realistic editorial photograph of an enterprise technology workspace: a desk with an open laptop and a smartphone in the foreground, modern glass office and server racks subtly visible in the background. No people, no brand logos, no legible screen text. Natural photographic depth, not a 3D render or an illustration.
TREATMENT: The entire photograph must be strictly neutral BLACK AND WHITE / GRAYSCALE. Absolutely no colors, no colored tints, no sepia, no accent hues. Cover the photo with a flat semi-transparent pure black overlay, approximately 60% opacity, so the actual photo remains clearly recognizable but dark enough for white text. This must be photographic editorial art, never a pastel illustration, clay render, infographic or plain colored background.
TEXT: Place the following exact Korean text centered horizontally and vertically on the dark photograph, on EXACTLY THREE LINES, bright white #FFFFFF, large bold professional Korean sans-serif. Text should occupy the central 70–75% width with generous 10% safe margins, airy line spacing, fully legible in a small blog card. No text boxes or cards. No dark lettering.
"유라클의 AI·모바일
네 가지 사업을
한눈에 살펴보기"
No additional words, no logos, no watermarks, no colored elements. No tiny subtitles or footer. No competitor branding. Keep the photographic composition visible around and behind the lettering. Match the restrained photo + black translucent overlay + large white centered headline approach shown in the references, rather than their precise photos.
